receipt_types.subject: physical or retrievable object bytes
receipt_types.establishes: Bounded statement that specified bytes were measured under a specified digest domain.

receipt_types.subject: transport event/container
receipt_types.establishes: Bounded transport evidence only; does not establish content interpretation or integration.

receipt_types.subject: platform-observed event
receipt_types.establishes: An event observed through a platform/API within the provider's assurance scope.

receipt_types.subject: validator run over fixed subject state
receipt_types.establishes: Result of named validation profile; scientific meaning remains bounded by the profile.

receipt_types.subject: typed attestation statement
receipt_types.establishes: Authenticated/bound statement existence and verification state, not truth of arbitrary predicate content.

receipt_types.subject: external log/registry inclusion or registration
receipt_types.establishes: External witness evidence under the log/registry semantics.

receipt_types.subject: message imprint / digest submitted to a timestamp authority
receipt_types.establishes: Trusted-time evidence according to timestamp protocol scope; not authorship or scientific validity.

receipt_types.subject: previous record/object assertion
receipt_types.establishes: Append-only correction/supersession relation without deleting historical evidence.

assurance_mapping.RA0_NONE: No receipt assurance beyond absence of a receipt.
assurance_mapping.RA1_SELF_ASSERTED: Producer/actor assertion without independent byte/platform authentication.
assurance_mapping.RA2_MUTUAL_BYTE_BOUND: Both sides bind the same transferred byte subject/digest within the defined protocol.
assurance_mapping.RA3_AUTHENTICATED_PLATFORM: Provider/platform identity/event evidence within platform semantics.
assurance_mapping.RA4_SIGNED_OR_TIMESTAMPED: Cryptographic signature or trusted timestamp verification established.
assurance_mapping.RA5_EXTERNAL_TRANSPARENCY_WITNESS: External transparency/registry witness established in addition to base evidence.
